opportunities.name: Open-source project lead research (HN + GitHub → Notes)
opportunities.description: For a given open-source project, find its top Hacker News story and its GitHub repo stats, then log a 'Lead:' line in Notes with HN points/age and GitHub stars/last release date.
opportunities.site: hn.algolia.com / news.ycombinator.com, github.com, internal Notes app
steps: Open Hacker News search (Algolia) and search for {project}
Read top story title, points and age
Open github.com, click Search and type {project}
Open the top repository result
Read star count and latest release date
Open Notes, click 'New note' and type 'Lead: {project}. HN "{top story title}" ({points} pts, {age}); GitHub {stars} stars, last release {date}'
Submit the note

instances.values: project=llama.cpp (HN 1311 pts, GitHub 131.1k stars, release Oct 5 2026)
project=Zed (HN 'Zed 1.0' 2153 pts, GitHub 91.7k stars, release Oct 12 2026)
project=Bun (HN 2192 pts, GitHub 96.2k stars, release Oct 10 2026)

opportunities.name: Company legal-story pitch (CourtListener + Wikipedia → email)
opportunities.description: For a given company, search CourtListener for court opinions involving it, look it up on Wikipedia for HQ/CEO, then email an editor a pitch summarizing the case.
steps: Open CourtListener and type {company} in the keyword search box
Click Search and open the top relevant opinion
Note case name, court and filing date
Open Wikipedia and search {company}; open the article
Note headquarters and CEO
Open mail compose; enter {recipient} in To
Enter subject 'Pitch: {company} in court'
Write body with case name, court, filing date, HQ and CEO; send

instances.values: company=Uber, case Uber v. Uber (Ohio Ct. App., Mar 31 2017), recipient=lena@example.com
company=Airbnb (CourtListener search, 412 opinions; no email seen)
company=Tesla (CourtListener search, then Wikipedia 'Tesla, Inc.'; no email seen)

opportunities.name: Country fact-check (World Bank indicator + BBC news → Notes)
opportunities.description: For a given country, look up a World Bank Open Data indicator such as life expectancy, find a related recent BBC News story, and log a 'Fact-check' note.
steps: Open World Bank Open Data and type {country} in the search box
Pick the country suggestion and read the indicator, e.g. life expectancy at birth
Open BBC, open the menu search and search '{country} {topic}'
Open or read the top result headline and date
Open Notes and add 'Fact-check {country}: {indicator} {value} ({year}). Context: {headline} ({age})'

instances.values: country=Kenya, topic=health, life expectancy 64 (2024), BBC Ebola story
country=Vietnam (Viet Nam, compared with Kenya: 75), topic=climate, BBC coffee beans story

opportunities.name: GitHub repository lookup
opportunities.description: Search GitHub for a project name and open the top repository to read its stars and latest release.
steps: Click the GitHub header Search box
Type {project} and press Enter
Open the top repository result
Read stars and latest release

opportunities.name: CourtListener case-law search
opportunities.description: Search CourtListener case law by company keyword and open a top opinion.
steps: Open CourtListener home or results page
Type {company} into the keyword search box
Click Search
Review the results and open the top opinion
